senses.sense_definition: het onder dreiging dwingen van iemand om geld te geven of handelingen te verrichten

examples.text: De crimineel werd gearresteerd wegens <w>afpersing</w> van lokale zakenlieden.

target_lang_translations.en: The criminal was arrested for <w>extortion</w> of local businessmen.

examples.text: Het slachtoffer durfde geen aangifte te doen van de voortdurende <w>afpersing</w> door de bende.

target_lang_translations.en: The victim did not dare to report the ongoing <w>extortion</w> by the gang.

target_lang_definitions.en: the act of forcing someone to give money or perform actions through threats

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the general act of obtaining something through force or threats
extortion specifically by threatening to reveal secrets or damaging information
organized illegal activities, often involving extortion
